verificationLimits: Original source bytes and graphs do not execute native C# or prove frame parity.

Native SequentialAbility eventless outgoing completion, countdown phase origin, reset-heal priority and transition facing dispatch unavailable. Local transition follows actual Front1s outgoing then selected-facing1s born; 20s substitute starts local mode entry.

Original mode1 fatal FinishDerivedBuff triggers return via buff-finish graph. Native priority against other fatal modifiers is not recovered; local guarded fatal prevents removal and clears temporary effects.

Native ON_OUTPUT_DAMAGE is mapped to accepted damaged output (including shield-absorbed0, excluding cancelled/dodged output and element gauges). Native callback order relative to victim damage/fatal and already-born projectiles is unverified.

PURE/NORMAL skipModifierEvent self cost uses applyHpLoss with native-type metadata; currentHP changes on S1 maxHP use existing simulator ratio preservation. Native currentHP correction, buff clearing and heal-free priority need client comparison.
Transition flag enums use existing substitute mappings; no additional immunity outside stun/freeze/sleep is inferred. No module, native particles/audio or game-frame parity.
